slot_scores.name: unclear_production_time_goal
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the 110-hour weekly production time limit a hard maximum that cannot be exceeded without incurring overtime, or is it the regular shift capacity where any production beyond it counts as overtime?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent probed the role of the 110-hour time limit as a capacity/overtime threshold, but it did not ask whether fully utilizing 110 hours is a soft goal, nor about its priority relative to minimizing overtime.

slot_scores.name: unclear_overtime_limit_goal
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is there a maximum limit on the total overtime hours allowed per week, or can overtime be any non-negative amount without an upper bound?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent asked whether an overtime cap exists and thereby discovered the 10-hour limit, but did not ask whether it is a strict constraint versus a soft goal or its priority relative to other objectives.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: The 110-hour weekly time should be treated simply as regular shift capacity, not as a prioritized full-utilization goal requiring trade-off consideration.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent listed 110 hours as confirmed regular capacity but never confirmed whether fully utilizing it is a soft goal or how it ranks against the overtime objective.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: The 10-hour overtime limit is a rigid maximum constraint rather than a prioritized soft goal.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent confirmed only that a maximum overtime limit exists; it did not confirm whether that limit is strict/soft or how it is prioritized.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent entered READY_TO_MODEL while both P0 hidden goal-structure slots were only partially addressed; neither the 110-hour utilization goal nor the 10-hour overtime limit was clarified as a soft/prioritized goal.

summary: The agent asked useful capacity and overtime-limit questions but never resolved the key preemptive goal-programming nature of the 110-hour utilization and 10-hour overtime limit before stopping.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
